content: # ============================================================================= # app.R — DSI online calculator (Shinylive) # ============================================================================= # Upload any CSV, then assign the variable roles in the sidebar (location, # dependent variable, predictors, model errors) — column names are free; # common names (lon/lat/y/error_*) are pre-selected automatically. # Everything runs in the visitor's browser via webR; no data leaves their # device. Method: Liu, Song & Yi (2026), IJGIS, doi:10.1080/13658816.2026.2614335 # ============================================================================= library(shiny) source("dsi-core.R") PALETTE_SEQ <- c("#FFF7EC", "#FDD49E", "#FC8D59", "#D7301F", "#7F0000") PALETTE_DIV <- c("#2166AC", "#92C5DE", "#F7F7F7", "#F4A582", "#B2182B") MODEL_COLS <- c("#4E79A7", "#F28E2B", "#59A14F", "#E15759", "#B6992D", "#499894", "#9D7660", "#B07AA1", "#86BCB6", "#FF9D9A") MAX_POINTS <- 10000 EXAMPLE_CSV <- "dsi-example-simulated.csv" sym_note <- function() tags$div(class = "note symtable", tags$b("Meaning of the symbols in the table and figures:"), tags$ul( tags$li(HTML("δ0a, δra — spatial autocorrelation (global Moran's I) of the observed response (δ0) and of a model's residuals (δr).")), tags$li(HTML("δ0h, δrh — spatial heterogeneity (geographical detector Q statistic) of the response and of the residuals.")), tags$li(HTML("ηa = (δ0a − δra)/δ0a — the share of the spatial autocorrelation in the data that the model has absorbed (explained); ηh — the same share for spatial heterogeneity.")), tags$li(HTML("θ1 (θmin) = min(ηa, ηh) — minimum interpretability: what the model explains if the two characteristics overlap completely.")), tags$li(HTML("θ2 (θprobable) = max(ηa, ηh) — most probable interpretability: the dominant spatial characteristic.")), tags$li(HTML("θ3 (θmax) = 1 − (1−ηa)(1−ηh) — maximum interpretability: what the model explains if the characteristics are independent.")), tags$li(HTML("Reading η and θ: near 1 — the residuals retain almost none of that spatial structure; near 0 — the model absorbed none of it; negative — the residuals carry more structure than the data itself.")) )) # -- UI ----------------------------------------------------------------------- ui <- fluidPage( tags$head(tags$style(HTML(" body { max-width: 1150px; margin: auto; } h2 { margin-top: 18px; } .well { background: #f7f9fb; } .note { color: #555; font-size: 13px; } .symtable ul { margin-bottom: 4px; } .symtable li { margin-bottom: 2px; } .cite { color: #555; font-size: 15px; border-left: 3px solid #4E79A7; padding-left: 10px; margin: 8px 0 22px 0; } .citehead { color: #333; font-size: 15px; margin: 22px 0 4px 0; } .dlrow { margin: 4px 0 18px 0; } .dlrow .btn { margin-right: 6px; } .scrollx { overflow-x: auto; } .scrollx table { font-size: 11.5px; white-space: nowrap; } .varlab { font-weight: 600; margin: 10px 0 2px 0; } table.data { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .dsi-hex-zoom { transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .dsi-hex-zoom:hover { transform: scale(1.12); } ")), # A plot rendered while the tab is in the background gets width 0 and shows # an error; nudge Shiny to re-measure when the tab becomes visible again. tags$script(HTML(" document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() { if (!document.hidden) { setTimeout(function() { window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); }, 250); } }); ")), # Browsers bypass the service worker for navigations (HTML # spec: downloads have service-workers mode 'none'), so in Shinylive the # native download click reaches the static host and 404s. Fetch the file # through the service worker instead and hand it over as a blob. tags$script(HTML(" document.addEventListener('click', function(e) { var a = e.target && e.target.closest('a.shiny-download-link'); if (!a || !a.getAttribute('href')) return; e.preventDefault(); fetch(a.href).then(function(resp) { if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + resp.status); var cd = resp.headers.get('content-disposition') || ''; var m = /filename\\*?=(?:UTF-8'')?\"?([^\";]+)\"?/i.exec(cd); var filename = m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : (a.download || 'download'); return resp.blob().then(function(blob) { var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); var tmp = document.createElement('a'); tmp.href = url; tmp.download = filename; document.body.appendChild(tmp); tmp.click(); tmp.remove(); setTimeout(function() { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 4000); }); }).catch(function(err) { alert('Download failed: ' + err.message + '. Compute the results first, then try again.'); }); }, true); "))), div(style = "display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; margin:18px 0 10px 0;", a(href = "https://yongzesong.com/app/dsi/", class = "dsi-hex-zoom", style = "flex:0 0 auto; line-height:0;", title = "DSI calculator", HTML('')), h2("DSI calculator — degree of spatial interpretability", style = "margin:0;")), p(class = "citehead", "To cite DSI (degree of spatial interpretability) in publications, please use:"), div(class = "cite", "Liu, H., Song, Y., & Yi, W. (2026). Degree of spatial interpretability. ", em("International Journal of Geographical Information Science. "), a(href = "https://doi.org/10.1080/13658816.2026.2614335", target = "_blank", "doi:10.1080/13658816.2026.2614335")), p(class = "note", "All computation runs locally in your browser (WebAssembly R). ", "Your data is never uploaded to any server."), sidebarLayout( sidebarPanel(width = 4, h4("1 · Data"), fileInput("file", "Upload CSV", accept = c(".csv", "text/csv")), div(class = "note", "Recommended data size: fewer than 10,000 spatial observations. ", "Column names are free — after loading, assign the variable roles ", "below (common names such as ", code("lon"), "/", code("lat"), "/", code("y"), "/", code("error_"), " are pre-selected ", "automatically). Coordinates must be WGS84 degrees. Residual = ", "observed − predicted; the sign convention does not affect DSI."), actionButton("example", "Load example data", class = "btn-sm"), downloadButton("dl_sample", "Sample CSV", class = "btn-sm"), div(class = "note", style = "margin-top: 4px;", "The example is the simulated multi-model dataset of the DSI ", "tutorial: 310 test points with columns ID, lon, lat, y, ", "6 predictors, and the residuals of 5 models (rpart, rf, xgbTree, ", "cubist, knn)."), hr(), h4("2 · Settings — variables"), div(class = "varlab", "Location (lon, lat)"), fluidRow( column(6, selectInput("var_lon", NULL, choices = c("lon…" = ""))), column(6, selectInput("var_lat", NULL, choices = c("lat…" = ""))) ), div(class = "varlab", "Dependent variable"), selectInput("var_y", NULL, choices = c("Select…" = "")), div(class = "varlab", "Independent variables (predictors)"), selectInput("var_pred", NULL, choices = character(0), multiple = TRUE, selectize = TRUE), div(class = "note", "Used for the paper's regression-tree stratification of the Q ", "statistic. Leave empty to fall back to k-means on coordinates."), div(class = "varlab", "Errors by one or multiple models"), selectInput("var_err", NULL, choices = character(0), multiple = TRUE, selectize = TRUE), div(class = "note", "One column per model; selecting several enables the model ", "comparison in the table and figures."), hr(), h4("3 · Settings — parameters"), numericInput("k", "k nearest neighbours (Moran's I)", value = 8, min = 2, max = 30, step = 1), selectInput("dist", "Distance for the kNN neighbourhood", choices = c("Great-circle, WGS-84 (any region)" = "greatcircle", "Projected EPSG:3577 (Australia — as in the paper)" = "albers3577")), numericInput("n_strata", "Strata for k-means fallback (Q)", value = 12, min = 2, max = 30, step = 1), div(class = "note", "Defaults follow the DSI paper (k = 8; EPSG:3577 for Australian-", "extent data)."), hr(), h4("4 · Compute"), actionButton("compute", "Compute DSI", class = "btn-primary") ), mainPanel(width = 8, h4("Data preview — first 6 rows"), uiOutput("preview_ui"), h4("Data summary"), verbatimTextOutput("summary", placeholder = TRUE), h4("Spatial distribution of the loaded data"), uiOutput("map_field_ui"), conditionalPanel("typeof input.map_field !== 'undefined'", plotOutput("map_plot", height = "340px")), div(class = "dlrow", downloadButton("dl_map", "Map PNG"), downloadButton("dl_map_pdf", "Map PDF (vector)")), h4("DSI results (Table 3)"), sym_note(), div(class = "note", HTML("Rows are sorted by θ3. ", "Moran's I p-values are included in the downloadable CSV.")), tableOutput("dsi"), div(class = "dlrow", downloadButton("dl_table", "DSI results CSV")), uiOutput("diagnostics"), h4("θ range by model"), div(class = "note", HTML("One triangle per model: base from ", "θ1 to θ3, apex (dashed line) at ", "θ2; models ordered by θ3.")), uiOutput("fig6_ui"), tableOutput("fig6_data"), div(class = "dlrow", downloadButton("dl_fig6_png", "θ plot PNG"), downloadButton("dl_fig6_pdf", "θ plot PDF (vector)"), downloadButton("dl_fig6_csv", "θ data CSV")), h4("Comparison of cross-validation DSI and accuracy metrics"), div(class = "note", HTML("Comparison of DSI and accuracy metrics-based ", "model validation: θ2 (point) with the ", "θ1–θ3 range (bar) against R², ", "RMSE and MAE computed from each model's residuals.")), conditionalPanel("input.compute > 0", plotOutput("fig7", height = "330px")), tableOutput("fig7_data"), div(class = "dlrow", downloadButton("dl_fig7_png", "Comparison plot PNG"), downloadButton("dl_fig7_pdf", "Comparison plot PDF (vector)"), downloadButton("dl_fig7_csv", "Comparison data CSV")) ) ), tags$details(style = "margin: 16px 0;", tags$summary("Method notes & data format"), tags$ul( tags$li("Spatial autocorrelation δᵃ: global Moran's I with row-standardised ", "k-nearest-neighbour weights; analytical randomisation test, ", "alternative = greater. Neighbour distances: great-circle (WGS-84) ", "for any region, or Euclidean in EPSG:3577 as in the paper's ", "Australian case study."), tags$li("Spatial heterogeneity δʰ: geographical detector Q statistic. ", "Strata come from a single regression tree fitted to the dependent ", "variable on the selected predictors (the paper's method); every ", "model's residuals are scored against the same strata. Without ", "predictors the tool falls back to k-means on standardised ", "coordinates."), tags$li("Accuracy: R² is the squared Pearson correlation between observed ", "and predicted (as reported by caret and the paper); RMSE and MAE ", "from the residuals."), tags$li("Rows with missing values in any selected column are dropped and ", "reported."), tags$li("This tool computes DSI only (no DG module). Implementation is ", "verified against spdep, the published tutorial code and the ", "published Table 3 values; see the project's validation report.") )) ) # -- Server ------------------------------------------------------------------- server <- function(input, output, session) { raw <- reactiveVal(NULL) # list(df, label) numericish <- function(v) is.numeric(v) || !all(is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v)))) # Load a data frame, then pre-select variable roles from common column names. populate <- function(df, label) { names(df) <- trimws(names(df)) raw(list(df = df, label = label)) cols <- names(df) numcols <- cols[vapply(df, numericish, logical(1))] guess1 <- function(pat) { m <- numcols[grepl(pat, numcols, ignore.case = TRUE)] if (length(m)) m[1] else "" } g_lon <- guess1("^(lon|longitude)$") g_lat <- guess1("^(lat|latitude)$") g_y <- guess1("^y$") g_err <- numcols[grepl("^(error|residual)(_.+)?$", numcols, ignore.case = TRUE)] g_id <- cols[cols == "" | grepl("^id$", cols, ignore.case = TRUE)] g_pred <- setdiff(numcols, c(g_lon, g_lat, g_y, g_err, g_id)) updateSelectInput(session, "var_lon", choices = c("lon…" = "", cols), selected = g_lon) updateSelectInput(session, "var_lat", choices = c("lat…" = "", cols), selected = g_lat) updateSelectInput(session, "var_y", choices = c("Select…" = "", cols), selected = g_y) updateSelectInput(session, "var_pred", choices = cols, selected = g_pred) updateSelectInput(session, "var_err", choices = cols, selected = g_err) } observeEvent(input$example, { populate(utils::read.csv(EXAMPLE_CSV, check.names = FALSE), "DSI tutorial simulated dataset (5 models, n = 310)") updateSelectInput(session, "dist", selected = "albers3577") }) observeEvent(input$file, { df <- tryCatch(utils::read.csv(input$file$datapath, check.names = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL) if (is.null(df)) { showNotification("Could not read that file as CSV.", type = "error") } else { populate(df, input$file$name) updateSelectInput(session, "dist", selected = "greatcircle") } }) # Display name for an error column: strip an error_/residual_ prefix. model_name <- function(cols) { nm <- sub("^(error|residual)_", "", cols, ignore.case = TRUE) nm[grepl("^(error|residual)$", cols, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "model" make.unique(nm) } # Current variable selection, validated. selection <- reactive({ r <- raw() validate(need(!is.null(r), "Load the example data or upload a CSV first.")) lon <- input$var_lon; lat <- input$var_lat; yv <- input$var_y err <- input$var_err validate( need(nzchar(lon), "Select the longitude column (Settings — variables)."), need(nzchar(lat), "Select the latitude column (Settings — variables)."), need(nzchar(yv), "Select the dependent variable (Settings — variables)."), need(length(err) >= 1, "Select at least one model-error column (Settings — variables)."), need(length(unique(c(lon, lat, yv))) == 3, "Longitude, latitude and the dependent variable must be three different columns."), need(!any(c(lon, lat, yv) %in% err), "The error columns must be different from location and dependent variable.") ) pred <- setdiff(input$var_pred, c(lon, lat, yv, err)) list(lon = lon, lat = lat, y = yv, err = err, pred = pred) }) # Working dataset built from the selection: numeric, complete rows only. built <- reactive({ r <- raw(); s <- selection() used <- c(s$lon, s$lat, s$y, s$err, s$pred) df <- r$df[, used, drop = FALSE] bad <- used[!vapply(df, numericish, logical(1))] validate(need(!length(bad), paste0( "Selected column(s) not numeric: ", paste(bad, collapse = ", ")))) for (cc in used) df[[cc]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[cc]])) keep <- stats::complete.cases(df) df <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE] validate( need(nrow(df) >= 30, paste0("Only ", nrow(df), " complete rows — at ", "least 30 are needed for a meaningful DSI.")), need(nrow(df) <= MAX_POINTS, paste0(nrow(df), " rows exceeds the ", "current limit of ", MAX_POINTS, " points for the in-browser version.")), need(all(abs(df[[s$lon]]) <= 360) && all(abs(df[[s$lat]]) <= 90), "Location values outside valid degree ranges — are these projected coordinates? This tool expects WGS84 degrees.") ) list(df = df, sel = s, dropped = sum(!keep), label = r$label) }) result <- eventReactive(input$compute, { b <- built(); df <- b$df; s <- b$sel k <- min(max(2, as.integer(input$k)), nrow(df) - 1) validate(need(is.finite(k) && k >= 2, "k must be at least 2.")) withProgress(message = "Computing DSI…", value = 0.2, { nb <- knn_neighbors(df[[s$lon]], df[[s$lat]], k, method = input$dist) incProgress(0.3, detail = "strata") strata <- if (length(s$pred)) { strata_tree(df[[s$y]], df[, s$pred, drop = FALSE], n_strata = as.integer(input$n_strata)) } else { strata_kmeans_coords(df[[s$lon]], df[[s$lat]], n_strata = as.integer(input$n_strata)) } incProgress(0.2, detail = "indicators") res <- df[, s$err, drop = FALSE] names(res) <- model_name(s$err) tab <- dsi_table(df[[s$y]], res, nb, strata) acc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res), function(m) { cbind(model = m, accuracy_metrics(df[[s$y]], res[[m]])) })) cmp <- merge(tab, acc, by = "model") cmp <- cmp[order(-cmp$theta_max), ] incProgress(0.3) list(tab = tab, cmp = cmp, notes = dsi_diagnostics(tab), df = df, sel = s, k = k, strata_method = attr(strata, "method"), n_strata = attr(strata, "n_strata"), dist = input$dist, label = b$label, dropped = b$dropped) }) }) # -- Data preview and summary ---------------------------------------------- output$preview_ui <- renderUI({ if (is.null(raw())) { return(div(class = "note", "Load the example data or upload a CSV to ", "see its first rows and columns here.")) } div(class = "scrollx", tableOutput("preview")) }) output$preview <- renderTable({ r <- raw(); req(r) utils::head(r$df, 6) }, striped = TRUE, digits = 3, class = "data") output$summary <- renderText({ r <- raw() if (is.null(r)) return("No data loaded yet.") s <- tryCatch(selection(), error = function(e) NULL) if (is.null(s)) { return(sprintf("Source: %s\nRows: %d, columns: %d\nAssign the variable roles in [2 · Settings — variables].", r$label, nrow(r$df), ncol(r$df))) } base <- sprintf( "Source: %s\nLocation: (%s, %s) Dependent: %s\nModels: %s\nPredictors: %s", r$label, s$lon, s$lat, s$y, paste(model_name(s$err), collapse = ", "), if (length(s$pred)) sprintf("%d (regression-tree stratification, paper method)", length(s$pred)) else "none (k-means on coordinates)") res <- if (input$compute > 0) tryCatch(result(), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL if (is.null(res)) return(paste0(base, "\nSet the parameters and press [Compute DSI].")) sprintf("%s\nComputed: %d points (%d dropped), k = %d, %s distances, strata = %s (%d strata).", base, nrow(res$df), res$dropped, res$k, if (res$dist == "albers3577") "EPSG:3577" else "great-circle", res$strata_method, res$n_strata) }) fmt3 <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x) output$dsi <- renderTable({ t <- result()$tab data.frame( Model = t$model, `δ₀ᵃ` = fmt3(t$delta0_moran), `δᵣᵃ` = fmt3(t$deltar_moran), `δ₀ʰ` = fmt3(t$delta0_q), `δᵣʰ` = fmt3(t$deltar_q), `ηᵃ` = fmt3(t$eta_autocorrelation), `ηʰ` = fmt3(t$eta_heterogeneity), `θ₁ (min)` = fmt3(t$theta_min), `θ₂ (probable)` = fmt3(t$theta_probable), `θ₃ (max)` = fmt3(t$theta_max), check.names = FALSE) }, striped = TRUE, class = "data", sanitize.text.function = identity) output$diagnostics <- renderUI({ r <- result() tags$div(class = "note", tags$b("Diagnostics: "), tags$ul(lapply(r$notes, tags$li))) }) # -- Theta range figure (paper Fig 6 style) --------------------------------- fig6_plot_fun <- function(tab) { t <- tab[order(-tab$theta_max), ] n <- nrow(t); t$row <- n:1 xr <- range(c(t$theta_min, t$theta_max)) off <- 0.035 * max(diff(xr), 0.05) xlim <- c(xr[1] - 5.5 * off, xr[2] + 5.5 * off) op <- par(mar = c(4, 8.5, 1, 1)); on.exit(par(op)) plot(NULL, xlim = xlim, ylim = c(0.55, n + 0.62), yaxt = "n", xlab = expression("Degree of spatial interpretability (DSI, " * theta * ")"), ylab = "") axis(2, at = t$row, labels = t$model, las = 1, cex.axis = 0.9) abline(h = t$row - 0.22, col = "grey88", lwd = 0.8) if (xlim[1] < 0) abline(v = 0, col = "grey70", lty = 2) for (i in seq_len(n)) { polygon(c(t$theta_min[i], t$theta_max[i], t$theta_probable[i]), c(t$row[i] - 0.22, t$row[i] - 0.22, t$row[i] + 0.30), col = "#cfe8f3", border = "black", lwd = 1) segments(t$theta_probable[i], t$row[i] - 0.22, t$theta_probable[i], t$row[i] + 0.30, lty = "22", col = "grey20") text(t$theta_min[i] - off, t$row[i] - 0.05, bquote(theta[1] ~ .(sprintf("(%.3f)", t$theta_min[i]))), pos = 2, cex = 0.75) text(t$theta_max[i] + off, t$row[i] - 0.05, bquote(theta[3] ~ .(sprintf("(%.3f)", t$theta_max[i]))), pos = 4, cex = 0.75) text(t$theta_probable[i], t$row[i] + 0.44, bquote(theta[2] ~ .(sprintf("(%.3f)", t$theta_probable[i]))), cex = 0.75) } box() } output$fig6_ui <- renderUI({ r <- result() h <- max(240, 95 * nrow(r$tab) + 80) plotOutput("fig6", height = paste0(h, "px")) }) output$fig6 <- renderPlot({ fig6_plot_fun(result()$tab) }) output$fig6_data <- renderTable({ t <- result()$tab data.frame(Model = t$model, `θ₁ (min)` = fmt3(t$theta_min), `θ₂ (probable)` = fmt3(t$theta_probable), `θ₃ (max)` = fmt3(t$theta_max), check.names = FALSE) }, striped = TRUE, class = "data") # -- DSI vs accuracy figure (paper Fig 7 style) ----------------------------- fig7_plot_fun <- function(cmp) { cols <- rep(MODEL_COLS, length.out = nrow(cmp)) pchs <- rep(c(0, 1, 2, 5, 6, 3, 4, 8, 7, 9), length.out = nrow(cmp)) ylim <- range(c(cmp$theta_min, cmp$theta_max)) ylim <- ylim + c(-0.06, 0.10) * max(diff(ylim), 0.1) op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(4, 4.2, 1, 0.8), pty = "s") on.exit(par(op)) panels <- list(list(v = cmp$R2, xlab = expression(R^2)), list(v = cmp$RMSE, xlab = "RMSE"), list(v = cmp$MAE, xlab = "MAE")) for (p in panels) { xr <- range(p$v) xpad <- max(0.08 * diff(xr), 0.06 * max(abs(xr)), 0.01) plot(NULL, xlim = xr + c(-xpad, xpad), ylim = ylim, xlab = p$xlab, ylab = expression(DSI(theta))) segments(p$v, cmp$theta_min, p$v, cmp$theta_max, col = "grey70", lwd = 2) segments(p$v - 0.25 * xpad, cmp$theta_min, p$v + 0.25 * xpad, cmp$theta_min, col = "grey70") segments(p$v - 0.25 * xpad, cmp$theta_max, p$v + 0.25 * xpad, cmp$theta_max, col = "grey70") points(p$v, cmp$theta_probable, col = cols, pch = pchs, cex = 1.4, lwd = 2) text(p$v, cmp$theta_probable, cmp$model, cex = 0.72, pos = 4, offset = 0.35, col = "grey20") box() } } output$fig7 <- renderPlot({ fig7_plot_fun(result()$cmp) }) output$fig7_data <- renderTable({ c <- result()$cmp data.frame(Model = c$model, `R²` = fmt3(c$R2), RMSE = fmt3(c$RMSE), MAE = fmt3(c$MAE), `θ₁ (min)` = fmt3(c$theta_min), `θ₂ (probable)` = fmt3(c$theta_probable), `θ₃ (max)` = fmt3(c$theta_max), check.names = FALSE) }, striped = TRUE, class = "data") # -- Map -------------------------------------------------------------------- output$map_field_ui <- renderUI({ s <- tryCatch(selection(), error = function(e) NULL) if (is.null(s)) return(NULL) ch <- c(s$y, s$err) names(ch) <- c(paste0(s$y, " (dependent)"), paste0("error: ", model_name(s$err))) selectInput("map_field", NULL, choices = ch, width = "60%") }) map_plot_fun <- function(df, s, field) { v <- df[[field]] diverging <- field %in% s$err pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(if (diverging) PALETTE_DIV else PALETTE_SEQ)(100) rng <- if (diverging) c(-1, 1) * max(abs(v)) else range(v) idx <- pmin(100, pmax(1, 1 + floor(99 * (v - rng[1]) / diff(rng)))) op <- par(mar = c(4, 4, 1, 1), pty = "s"); on.exit(par(op)) plot(df[[s$lon]], df[[s$lat]], col = pal[idx], pch = 16, cex = 0.9, xlab = s$lon, ylab = s$lat, asp = 1 / cospi(mean(df[[s$lat]]) / 180)) qs <- signif(seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = 5), 3) legend("topright", bty = "n", cex = 0.8, title = field, legend = qs, pch = 16, col = pal[c(1, 25, 50, 75, 100)]) box() } output$map_plot <- renderPlot({ b <- built(); req(input$map_field, input$map_field %in% names(b$df)) map_plot_fun(b$df, b$sel, input$map_field) }) # -- Downloads -------------------------------------------------------------- png_of <- function(draw, w, h) function(f) { grDevices::png(f, width = w, height = h, res = 220) draw(); grDevices::dev.off() } # Vector export; Greek letters are drawn as plotmath, so the portable pdf() # device renders them on any platform. pdf_of <- function(draw, w_in, h_in) function(f) { grDevices::pdf(f, width = w_in, height = h_in, useDingbats = FALSE) draw(); grDevices::dev.off() } output$dl_sample <- downloadHandler( filename = function() "dsi-sample.csv", content = function(f) file.copy(EXAMPLE_CSV, f, overwrite = TRUE)) output$dl_table <- downloadHandler( filename = function() "dsi-results.csv", content = function(f) utils::write.csv(result()$tab, f, row.names = FALSE)) output$dl_fig6_png <- downloadHandler( filename = function() "dsi-theta-range.png", content = function(f) { r <- result() png_of(function() fig6_plot_fun(r$tab), 1700, round(220 / 96 * (95 * nrow(r$tab) + 80)))(f) }) output$dl_fig6_csv <- downloadHandler( filename = function() "dsi-theta-range-data.csv", content = function(f) { t <- result()$tab utils::write.csv(data.frame(model = t$model, theta_min = t$theta_min, theta_probable = t$theta_probable, theta_max = t$theta_max), f, row.names = FALSE) }) output$dl_fig7_png <- downloadHandler( filename = function() "dsi-accuracy-comparison.png", content = function(f) { r <- result(); png_of(function() fig7_plot_fun(r$cmp), 2200, 850)(f) }) output$dl_fig7_csv <- downloadHandler( filename = function() "dsi-accuracy-comparison-data.csv", content = function(f) { c <- result()$cmp utils::write.csv(c[, c("model", "R2", "RMSE", "MAE", "theta_min", "theta_probable", "theta_max")], f, row.names = FALSE) }) output$dl_map <- downloadHandler( filename = function() "dsi-map.png", name: dsi-core.R
content:
# =============================================================================
# dsi-core.R — DSI computation core for the browser (base R only)
# =============================================================================
# Ported from the DSI tutorial pipeline (reproduce/DSI, files 02-spatial-
# metrics.R and 03-dsi.R). Liu, Song & Yi (2026), IJGIS,
# https://doi.org/10.1080/13658816.2026.2614335
#
# Base R replaces spdep/sf so the WebAssembly payload stays small; the
# replacements are verified against spdep in validation/validate.R.
# =============================================================================

# -- Neighbourhood ------------------------------------------------------------

# Great-circle distances (km) from one point to a set of points.
# Andoyer-Lambert approximation on the WGS-84 ellipsoid — the same formula as
# spdep's C gcdist() (src/dnn.c), so neighbour sets match spdep exactly.
gcdist_km <- function(lon0, lat0, lon, lat) {
  rad <- pi / 180
  a  <- 6378.137            # WGS-84 equatorial radius, km
  f  <- 1 / 298.257223563   # WGS-84 flattening

  F <- (lat0 + lat) / 2 * rad
  G <- (lat0 - lat) / 2 * rad
  L <- (lon0 - lon) / 2 * rad

  sinG2 <- sin(G)^2; cosG2 <- cos(G)^2
  sinF2 <- sin(F)^2; cosF2 <- cos(F)^2
  sinL2 <- sin(L)^2; cosL2 <- cos(L)^2

  S <- sinG2 * cosL2 + cosF2 * sinL2
  C <- cosG2 * cosL2 + sinF2 * sinL2

  w <- atan(sqrt(S / C))
  R <- sqrt(S * C) / w

  D  <- 2 * w * a
  H1 <- (3 * R - 1) / (2 * C)
  H2 <- (3 * R + 1) / (2 * S)

  d <- D * (1 + f * H1 * sinF2 * cosG2 - f * H2 * cosF2 * sinG2)
  d[!is.finite(d)] <- 0     # coincident points: S = 0 makes w, R undefined
  d
}

# Forward Albers equal-area conic on the GRS80 ellipsoid with the EPSG:3577
# (GDA94 / Australian Albers) parameters — the projected CRS of the DSI paper.
# Snyder (1987) eqs 14-1..14-4; verified against sf::st_transform in
# validation/validate.R.
albers3577_xy <- function(lon, lat) {
  a  <- 6378137
  f  <- 1 / 298.257222101
  e2 <- f * (2 - f); e <- sqrt(e2)
  rad <- pi / 180
  lam0 <- 132 * rad; phi0 <- 0
  phi1 <- -18 * rad; phi2 <- -36 * rad

  mfun <- function(phi) cos(phi) / sqrt(1 - e2 * sin(phi)^2)
  qfun <- function(phi) (1 - e2) * (sin(phi) / (1 - e2 * sin(phi)^2) -
    (1 / (2 * e)) * log((1 - e * sin(phi)) / (1 + e * sin(phi))))

  n  <- (mfun(phi1)^2 - mfun(phi2)^2) / (qfun(phi2) - qfun(phi1))
  C  <- mfun(phi1)^2 + n * qfun(phi1)
  rho0 <- a * sqrt(C - n * qfun(phi0)) / n

  phi <- lat * rad
  th  <- n * (lon * rad - lam0)
  rho <- a * sqrt(C - n * qfun(phi)) / n
  cbind(x = rho * sin(th), y = rho0 - rho * cos(th))
}

#' k-nearest-neighbour sets.
#'
#' method "greatcircle": Andoyer WGS-84 distances, valid for any region.
#' method "albers3577": Euclidean distances in EPSG:3577 — the DSI paper's
#' setting for the Australian case study.
#' @return n x k integer matrix; row i holds the indices of i's neighbours
knn_neighbors <- function(lon, lat, k, method = c("greatcircle", "albers3577")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  n <- length(lon)
  if (k >= n) stop("k (", k, ") must be smaller than the number of points (", n, ").")
  if (method == "albers3577") {
    xy <- albers3577_xy(lon, lat)
    t(vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
      d <- (xy[, 1] - xy[i, 1])^2 + (xy[, 2] - xy[i, 2])^2
      d[i] <- Inf
      order(d)[seq_len(k)]
    }, integer(k)))
  } else {
    t(vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
      d <- gcdist_km(lon[i], lat[i], lon, lat)
      d[i] <- Inf
      order(d)[seq_len(k)]
    }, integer(k)))
  }
}

# -- Spatial autocorrelation --------------------------------------------------

#' Global Moran's I with row-standardised kNN weights and the analytical
#' randomisation test (mirrors spdep::moran.test defaults).
moran_i <- function(x, nb, alternative = "greater") {
  n <- length(x)
  k <- ncol(nb)
  if (all(abs(x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) < .Machine$double.eps^0.5)) {
    return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_))
  }
  z  <- x - mean(x)
  m2 <- sum(z^2) / n

  # I with row-standardised weights: S0 = n, each neighbour weighted 1/k
  lag_z <- rowMeans(matrix(z[nb], nrow = n))
  I <- sum(z * lag_z) / sum(z^2) * n / n  # (n/S0) * sum(w z z') / sum(z^2), S0 = n

  # S1, S2 for the variance; w_ij is 1/k when j is a neighbour of i
  w <- 1 / k
  in_nb <- function(i, j) any(nb[j, ] == i)
  S1 <- 0
  colsum <- numeric(n)                    # c_j = sum_i w_ij
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    for (j in nb[i, ]) {
      colsum[j] <- colsum[j] + w
      S1 <- S1 + if (in_nb(i, j)) 0.5 * (2 * w)^2 else w^2
    }
  }
  S0 <- n
  S2 <- sum((1 + colsum)^2)               # row sums are all 1

  EI <- -1 / (n - 1)
  b2 <- (sum(z^4) / n) / m2^2
  VI <- (n * ((n^2 - 3 * n + 3) * S1 - n * S2 + 3 * S0^2) -
           b2 * ((n^2 - n) * S1 - 2 * n * S2 + 6 * S0^2)) /
        ((n - 1) * (n - 2) * (n - 3) * S0^2) - EI^2

  zscore <- (I - EI) / sqrt(VI)
  p <- switch(alternative,
    greater   = pnorm(zscore, lower.tail = FALSE),
    less      = pnorm(zscore, lower.tail = TRUE),
    two.sided = 2 * pnorm(abs(zscore), lower.tail = FALSE)
  )
  list(estimate = I, p_value = p)
}

# -- Spatial heterogeneity ----------------------------------------------------

#' Strata from a regression tree on the predictors — the DSI paper's method.
#'
#' A single rpart tree fitted to the response on all predictors; its leaves are
#' the strata, and every model's residuals are scored against these same strata
#' (ported from the paper's original code and the tutorial's make_strata()).
#' Falls back to k-means on the standardised predictors when the tree
#' degenerates to a single leaf.
strata_tree <- function(y, predictors, n_strata = 12, seed = 42) {
  d <- data.frame(y = y, predictors, check.names = TRUE)
  fit <- rpart::rpart(y ~ ., data = d)
  strata <- as.factor(as.numeric(fit$where))
  if (nlevels(strata) >= 2) {
    return(structure(strata, method = "tree", n_strata = nlevels(strata)))
  }
  x <- scale(as.matrix(predictors))
  x[!is.finite(x)] <- 0
  k <- min(n_strata, max(2, floor(length(y) / 10)))
  set.seed(seed)
  km <- stats::kmeans(x, centers = k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 50)
  structure(as.factor(km$cluster), method = "kmeans-predictors", n_strata = k)
}

#' Strata from k-means on standardised coordinates.
#'
#' Used only when the uploaded CSV carries no predictor columns, so space
#' itself is partitioned. Same k-means settings as the tutorial's
#' make_strata(): seed, nstart = 25, and the floor(n/10) cap on strata count.
strata_kmeans_coords <- function(lon, lat, n_strata = 12, seed = 42) {
  x <- scale(cbind(lon, lat))
  x[!is.finite(x)] <- 0
  k <- min(n_strata, max(2, floor(length(lon) / 10)))
  set.seed(seed)
  km <- stats::kmeans(x, centers = k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 50)
  structure(as.factor(km$cluster), method = "kmeans-coords", n_strata = k)
}

#' Q statistic of the geographical detector (sum-of-squares form, ported
#' verbatim from the tutorial).
q_statistic <- function(x, strata) {
  strata <- as.factor(strata)
  keep <- is.finite(x) & !is.na(strata)
  x <- x[keep]; strata <- droplevels(strata[keep])
  sst <- sum((x - mean(x))^2)
  if (sst <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  ssw <- sum(vapply(split(x, strata), function(v) sum((v - mean(v))^2), numeric(1)))
  1 - ssw / sst
}

# -- One-call measurement of a field ------------------------------------------

measure_field <- function(values, nb, strata, alternative = "greater") {
  m <- moran_i(values, nb, alternative)
  list(moran = m$estimate, moran_p = m$p_value, q = q_statistic(values, strata))
}

# -- DSI ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ported verbatim from 03-dsi.R (log_warn dropped).

dsi_eta <- function(delta_0, delta_r) {
  if (is.na(delta_0) || is.na(delta_r)) return(NA_real_)
  if (abs(delta_0) < 1e-8) return(NA_real_)
  (delta_0 - delta_r) / delta_0
}

dsi_theta <- function(etas) {
  etas <- etas[!is.na(etas)]
  if (!length(etas)) {
    return(list(theta_min = NA_real_, theta_probable = NA_real_, theta_max = NA_real_))
  }
  list(
    theta_min      = min(etas),
    theta_probable = max(etas),
    theta_max      = 1 - prod(1 - etas)
  )
}

dsi_for_model <- function(model_name, response, residual, nb, strata,
                          alternative = "greater") {
  obs <- measure_field(response, nb, strata, alternative)
  res <- measure_field(residual, nb, strata, alternative)

  eta_a <- dsi_eta(obs$moran, res$moran)
  eta_h <- dsi_eta(obs$q,     res$q)
  theta <- dsi_theta(c(eta_a, eta_h))

  data.frame(
    model          = model_name,
    delta0_moran   = obs$moran,
    deltar_moran   = res$moran,
    moran_p_data   = obs$moran_p,
    moran_p_resid  = res$moran_p,
    delta0_q       = obs$q,
    deltar_q       = res$q,
    eta_autocorrelation = eta_a,
    eta_heterogeneity   = eta_h,
    theta_min      = theta$theta_min,
    theta_probable = theta$theta_probable,
    theta_max      = theta$theta_max
  )
}

dsi_table <- function(response, residuals, nb, strata, alternative = "greater") {
  rows <- lapply(names(residuals), function(m) {
    dsi_for_model(m, response, residuals[[m]], nb, strata, alternative)
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  out[order(-out$theta_max, -out$theta_probable), ]
}

dsi_diagnostics <- function(dsi) {
  notes <- character(0)
  if (any(dsi$moran_p_data > 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    notes <- c(notes, paste0(
      "The response shows no significant spatial autocorrelation (p > 0.05). ",
      "eta for autocorrelation is not interpretable; rely on the heterogeneity ",
      "component alone."))
  }
  neg <- dsi$model[dsi$eta_autocorrelation < 0 | dsi$eta_heterogeneity < 0]
  neg <- neg[!is.na(neg)]
  if (length(neg)) {
    notes <- c(notes, paste0(
      "Negative eta for: ", paste(neg, collapse = ", "),
      ". These models leave residuals with more spatial structure than the ",
      "response itself — a substantive finding, not an error."))
  }
  wide <- dsi$model[(dsi$theta_max - dsi$theta_min) > 0.5]
  wide <- wide[!is.na(wide)]
  if (length(wide)) {
    notes <- c(notes, paste0(
      "Wide theta range for: ", paste(wide, collapse = ", "),
      ". Each of these models handles one spatial characteristic well and the ",
      "other poorly."))
  }
  if (!length(notes)) notes <- "No diagnostic flags raised."
  notes
}

# -- Accuracy metrics ---------------------------------------------------------

#' R2, RMSE and MAE for one model, from its residuals (residual = y - yhat).
#'
#' R2 is the squared Pearson correlation between observed and predicted — what
#' caret reports and therefore what the DSI paper reports (tutorial
#' 01-helpers.R, accuracy_metrics()).
accuracy_metrics <- function(y, residual) {
  keep <- is.finite(y) & is.finite(residual)
  y <- y[keep]; predicted <- y - residual[keep]
  data.frame(
    n    = length(y),
    R2   = stats::cor(y, predicted)^2,
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((y - predicted)^2)),
    MAE  = mean(abs(y - predicted))
  )
}
